environment.description: Same application deployed behind Azure API Management (APIM) Premium tier with VNet injection. The APIM instance enforces inbound processing policies: (1) a validate-jwt policy on all /api/* routes requiring a valid tenant-scoped JWT with 'tid' claim matching the {tenantId} path parameter, where token signing keys are held exclusively in a Thales Luna Network HSM 7 (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) accessed via PKCS#11 — the APIM policy references the HSM-backed certificate for JWT validation and the application never possesses exportable key material; (2) a set-header policy that strips any inbound X-Config-Override header before forwarding to the backend; (3) the App Service has access restrictions allowing traffic only from the APIM subnet (10.0.1.0/24). The HSM partition access is controlled via an HSM client certificate stored in Azure Key Vault (purge-protected, no export), and the APIM managed identity has GET permission only on the specific certificate version used for JWT validation.

config.jwt_validation: validate-jwt policy requiring 'tid' claim == {tenantId} path param
config.signing_keys: Thales Luna Network HSM 7, PKCS#11, FIPS 140-2 L3, non-exportable
config.network_restriction: App Service access restricted to APIM subnet 10.0.1.0/24 only
config.key_vault: Purge-protected, managed identity GET-only on cert version
config.hsm_access: Client cert in Key Vault, partition-level ACL
